description: This file is a C header file defining the RTE (Runtime Environment) interface for an embedded ECU project. It declares external variables, functions for reading sensor/button status, controlling LEDs via hardware abstraction, and managing GPT (General Purpose Timer) operations.

methods.name: Rte_Read_RP_ButtonStatusInfo_ButtonStatus
methods.description: Reads button status information from a buffer, likely sent from an external application or CAN message.

methods.name: Rte_Call_PP_LedControl_LedSet
methods.description: Controls an LED by setting its level via hardware abstraction layer.

methods.name: Rte_Call_PP_GptControl_GptStartTicks
methods.description: Starts a GPT timer with specified tick duration.

methods.name: Rte_Call_PP_GptControl_GptRegisterCb
methods.description: Registers a callback function for GPT timer events.
